impact_definition.reason: native key at the first local minimum of the downward shovel stroke; defined before checking blade height

edge_classification.rigid: both vertices have exactly one identical bone weight > 0.999; 1% threshold applies
edge_classification.blend: joint/clothing transition; reported p95/max separately and never silently removed

collision_classification.visible: BVH test on garment surfaces and exposed lower-arm/wrist/hand triangles; quality threshold applies
collision_classification.covered_internal: full continuous arm volume hidden under a sleeve; raw excess retained in every audited pose
collision_classification.expected_seam: intentional garment boundary overlap; measured separately, never deleted

reference_deviations.Ranger is comparison only: Prior report remains in reviews/digging-measures; no Ranger PASS assumption.

limitations: Hand distance samples low-poly hand-surface vertices against the fitted finite shaft capsule; it does not prove finger wrapping or absence of tool penetration.
Collision depth remains a BVH/nearest-surface proxy. Hidden continuous upper-arm skin is reported as covered_internal_overlap; same-family nested clothing is inspected visually.
Both feet are annotated as support for the full in-place Digging cycle; no interval is dropped based on measured velocity.
